title: Calibrated U on the locked 1 mm moved event
question: Can locked U be read as a probability for the same 1 mm moved event it ranks?

P.citation: Zadrozny & Elkan 2002; sklearn IsotonicRegression increasing=True out_of_bounds=clip

y.event: max relchange on {±1} mm six-axis counts > 0.25 and max(C0, C_1mm) >= 10
y.mask: triu max(C0 and all 18 planted maps) >= 10

high_bin.rule: highest equal-width bin m in 1..10 with n>=20 of calibrated P on the fit set; freeze that m before test ECE

win: ECE(calibrated U) < ECE(raw U) on held-out TBI AND the frozen high bin is evaluable (n>=20) and |mean_y - mean_P| <= 0.15
fail: any miss. Keep U as a ranker. Do not print U as a percent. Not hat{U}.
